description: Travel Monitoring Analysis System (TMAS) Traffic Volume 2021 is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Roadways and Bridges", published or maintained by FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. 2021 Traffic Volume Data from FHWA's TMAS Data Program. Unweighted raw continuous traffic count information collected by state highway agencies. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Roadways and Bridges". It has 13 columns, among them Functional System, Day of Week, Direction, Lane, Month, Rural/Urban. The portal shows 2025-06-20 as the last data update. Attribution given: FHWA, Office of Highway Policy Information. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
